youtube.title: Zebra ki dhaariyan sher se bachne ke liye nahi hain, toh phir kyun? 🦓 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Zebra ki dhaariyan sher se chhupne ke liye nahi hain. Saalon tak scientists ne purane ideas test kiye: camouflage, shikaariyon ko confuse karna, aur thanda rehna.

Britain mein researchers ne ghodon ko dhaaridaar coat pehnaaye. Kaatne wali makkhiyaan unpe aayin, par zyaadatar baith nahi paayin. Africa mein ye makkhiyaan jaanleva bimaariyan faila sakti hain.

The Hidden Why ka Hindi edition: roz ki cheezon ke peeche ki asli wajah.
